title: Released a super early testing build of my hex tile game!
author: RealAstropulse
selftext:
If anyone wants to give it a go, here's the link:

[https://github.com/Astropulse/wip-hex-tile-game](https://github.com/Astropulse/wip-hex-tile-game)

The game is played similar to Settlers of Catan, just bigger with more resources and structures. There isn't a winning condition yet since I'm still filling out most of the rules and gameplay.  


It's not playtested yet, getting some friends together this weekend to do a run or two.

You keep track of resources yourself, I've actually 3d printed some tokens I use for that: [https://www.printables.com/model/1616810-resource-tokens](https://www.printables.com/model/1616810-resource-tokens)

replies.author: RuleElectronic6044
replies.body: Hi Astro, I found Retro Diffusion very useful. I am making a retro game and would like to automate the process of creating sprites. I wonder if you had a complete API #schema# other than the API examples on https://github.com/Retro-Diffusion/api-examples. Thank you and your collegues.

replies.author: RealAstropulse
replies.body: Not a complete schema, just those example docs. There is an MCP though, which is very useful for having AI agents interact with the api if you want that. It's down near the bottom of those docs.
